Prompt: A cute retro-futuristic robot portrait, chest-up, centered, facing forward. The robot is Ajax, the legendary giant hero of the Trojan War: it wears a polished bronze Corinthian-style helmet with an open face and a tall, flowing crimson horsehair crest, and holds the top rim of a huge round bronze shield up at one shoulder, the rim decorated with a simple Greek key pattern. Burnished bronze and Aegean-blue plating, with one small glowing status light on its chest. The robot's face is a dark rounded rectangular screen showing simple glowing dot-matrix eyes (curved, happy) and a small smile. Behind it: deep magenta velvet stage curtains, and a large heart outline made of glowing round marquee light bulbs framing the robot's head. Warm rim lighting from the bulbs, soft bloom, shallow depth of field. Polished glossy 3D render, painterly, charming and friendly. Framed in a thick rounded-square warm gold and copper metallic bezel like an app icon. The area outside the rounded corners is pure black, edge to edge — no white background, no margin, no drop shadow. No readable text, letters or words anywhere. Square 1:1 composition.
